This topic is part of the IB SL IBDP Religious Studies specification.

Religious Practices & Rituals appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The IB SL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
